### Borea v0.6.24

A patch release for playing with less memory in use and tidier menus. Update with "Update now" on the Home banner, or with `borea update-self`.

[Website](https://ksamodding.github.io/Borea/) | [Discord](https://discord.gg/nt4fK4QuTz) | [Content index](https://github.com/KSAModding/content-index) | [Source and issues](https://github.com/KSAModding/Borea)

#### New

- New setting "When the game starts" in General settings: keep Borea open, minimize it, or close it. With Close, Borea opens again by itself when the game ends, so the game gets the memory Borea would use while you play. Borea stays open while a task still runs and when the launch fails.

#### Improved

- Every "..." menu now lists its actions in the same order, with separators between groups and the destructive action last and in red.
- The header of an instance page turns into one compact line while you scroll down its list, and the long pages get the "Back to top" button that Discover already had.

Full changelog: [v0.6.23...v0.6.24](https://github.com/KSAModding/Borea/compare/v0.6.23...v0.6.24)
